mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.8%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.3 million units per month signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers preemptive monetary tightening and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and triggers a forward-looking equity market sell-off due to anticipated rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that monetary policy is not keeping pace with inflation, leading to real rate compression and equity market repricing downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls above 200k signals a labor market that is overheating, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to a forward-looking equity market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS exceeds 200k, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially when inflation remains stable.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term's Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
